conditions: norm_matched_random_error: x + ||x - x_hat|| u, u isotropic Gaussian unit vector; generator seeded by (model, layer, doc rank) so every SAE of a (model, layer, doc) gets the SAME directions (paired across SAEs)
mean_ablation: mean of the layer over the 64 reference documents' non-BOS tokens

reconstruction.EV: higher; M6 definition with per-document sums (exact pooled mean via stored per-document sum_x)

behaviour_normalised (cross-model use).ratio_sae_over_random: >1 = SAE error more harmful than random error of equal norm

uncertainty: 1000 document-bootstrap resamples, seed 0, percentile 95% CI; for cross-model differences the SAME resample indices are used for both models (paired by document, since both see identical text). Seeds (in-house) are reported as mean and per-seed values; cross-model intervals use the per-SAE doc bootstrap pooled over seeds by averaging per resample.

hypotheses.XB_H1: Per model, corpus and SAE: dCE_sae > dCE_random (paired doc-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 = supported; upper < 0 = contradicted; else inconclusive). Holm over SAEs within each (model, corpus) family using bootstrap p = share of resamples with d <= 0 (two-sided doubled).
hypotheses.XB_H2 (descriptive, cross-model): Within each depth triplet and corpus: paired differences gemma - gpt2 of loss_recovered, ratio, excess_rel, dCE_rel, KL_over_KL_mean, for each SAE track. A difference is only called 'cross-model difference' inside a MATCHED stratum (below) and when its 95% CI excludes 0; everything else is labelled 'unmatched, descriptive'.
hypotheses.XB_H3 (descriptive): Within each model: Spearman correlation of dCE_rel and ratio with depth fraction across all layers (canonical/public SAE track).

comparison_tracks.public_vs_public: GPT-2 res-jb (ReLU 32x) vs Gemma Scope (JumpReLU): DIFFERENT architectures, never called architecture-matched
comparison_tracks.inhouse_vs_public: GPT-2 R2 (TopK/BatchTopK/ReLU 16x, L0 128) vs Gemma Scope 16k canonical: training-history mismatch disclosed
comparison_tracks.matched_stratum: a GPT-2 SAE and a Gemma SAE at the same triplet position are MATCHED iff measured L0/d_model AND d_sae/d_model each agree within +-15% (ratio in [0.85, 1.15]); candidate pairs res-jb <-> Gemma 65k ladder, R2 <-> Gemma 32k at L12 (batch 2)
comparison_tracks.within_model: every model's own SAEs vs its random/mean controls

gates.V_IDENT: identity splice: |dCE| < 1e-6 (gpt2 fp32) / < 1e-3 (gemma bf16) and KL < 1e-6 / 1e-3 on the first 8 docs
